title.rendered: René Muñoz Wins $2.4M for Injured Worker | Workers’ Comp Victory

content.rendered:
(Updated January 24, 2026)

René Muñoz Wins $2.4 Million in Workers’ Compensation Case

For anyone seeking guidance from a seasoned Rene Muñoz workers’ compensation attorney, this article can provide helpful insights.  At Franco Muñoz Law Firm, we fight tirelessly to ensure our clients receive the maximum compensation they deserve. In a recent case, René Muñoz proved why having an experienced attorney makes all the difference. His relentless dedication led to a $2.4 million award and lifetime medical care for his client.

Insurance Denial: The Initial Challenge

From the start, the insurance company denied the claim, arguing that the injury was not work-related. This is a common tactic used to minimize payouts, but René Muñoz fought back. He gathered compelling evidence, proving beyond doubt that the injury was job-related.

Lowball Offers & Aggressive Negotiation

After proving the injury occurred, the insurance company made an insulting offer of just $40,000. Later, they increased it to $225,000, still far below what the client deserved. René refused to accept less than full justice.

The Victory: $2.4 Million & Lifetime Medical Care

On the eve of trial, the insurance company still refused to settle fairly. With no other option, René Muñoz took the case to court, where the judge awarded 100% permanent disability, ensuring lifetime medical care and a total payout of $2,410,103.

Why Choose Franco Muñoz Law Firm?

This case highlights why having the right workers’ compensation attorney matters. Insurance companies often delay, deny, or minimize compensation. At Franco Muñoz Law Firm, we fight back to secure the best possible outcome for our clients.

Need Legal Help?

If you or a loved one has been injured at work and is facing insurance challenges, don’t settle for less. Call us today at (510) 257-4141 or schedule a free consultation.

About the Author: René Muñoz

René Muñoz is a leading workers’ compensation attorney with years of experience securing six- and seven-figure settlements for injured workers. He has successfully fought for lifetime medical care and maximum compensation for his clients. Learn more about his background here.
